'''Limestone''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].  A [[Coral]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 1 Limestone when the population of the pond reaches 9.

==Bundles==
Limestone is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Limestone is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Limestone is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt102|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a gray dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
1 Limestone may be requested by [[Bullhead]] or [[Largemouth Bass]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].  Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. Can be produced by [[Fish Pond|Fish Ponds]].}}
{{History|1.6|Is no longer a possible Midnight Carp Fish Pond request.}}
